quests.instruction: Find the tool that makes paper sticky so two pieces join together!
quests.question: Glue Stick
quests.hint: You twist it up like a small tube before you rub it on paper.
quests.explanation: That's right! We twist up a glue stick and rub it onto paper to stick things.
quests.funFact: A glue stick dries clear, so you can barely see it on your paper!

quests.instruction: Touch the tool that needs its lid closed so it will not dry out!
quests.question: Marker
quests.hint: It has a cap you must remember to put back on.
quests.explanation: Yes! A marker draws bold, colorful lines on paper or a whiteboard.
quests.funFact: Markers can dry out if you forget to put the cap back on!

quests.instruction: Touch the chart that shows every day, week, and month of the year!
quests.question: Calendar
quests.hint: You check it to find out today's date or a special day.
quests.explanation: That's right! We check a calendar to find today's date.
quests.funFact: A calendar shows twelve months, and each month has its own number of days!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the place where children laugh, run, and climb outside!
quests.question: Playground
quests.hint: You visit this place during recess to play with your friends.
quests.explanation: Yes! A playground is the outdoor place where we play during recess.
quests.funFact: Many playgrounds have slides, swings, and climbing bars all in one place!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the school leader who welcomes new students on their first day!
quests.question: Principal
quests.hint: This person's office often welcomes visitors who come to the school.
quests.explanation: Yes! A principal is the person who leads and takes care of the whole school.
quests.funFact: A principal often visits many classrooms in just one single school day!

quests.instruction: Touch the container that keeps our snacks safe until lunchtime!
quests.question: Lunchbox
quests.hint: You open it at lunchtime to find your sandwich or snack inside.
quests.explanation: Yes! A lunchbox carries our food safely to school until it's time to eat.
quests.funFact: Some lunchboxes have special cool packs inside to keep food fresh and cold!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the helper who stamps and organizes every returned book!
quests.question: Librarian
quests.hint: You can ask this person to help you find a good book.
quests.explanation: Yes! A librarian takes care of the library and helps us find books.
quests.funFact: A librarian often knows hundreds of book titles and where each one belongs!

quests.instruction: Find the stick that leaves a soft, powdery mark on a blackboard!
quests.question: Chalk
quests.hint: A wet or dry cloth can wipe its marks away easily.
quests.explanation: Well done! Chalk helps a teacher write a lesson for the whole class to see.
quests.funFact: Outdoor chalk lets children draw colorful pictures right on the sidewalk!

quests.instruction: Touch the tool that helps your paper look neat after a mistake!
quests.question: Eraser
quests.hint: Rub it gently over a pencil mark and watch it disappear.
quests.explanation: That's right! We use an eraser to clean up little writing mistakes.
quests.funFact: Before rubber erasers, people used soft bread to rub out pencil marks!

quests.instruction: Find the bag that holds your books safely on the walk to school!
quests.question: Backpack
quests.hint: You wear this bag on your back with two straps over your shoulders.
quests.explanation: That's right! We wear a backpack on our shoulders to carry our things.
quests.funFact: Some backpacks have a special pocket just the right size for a water bottle!

quests.instruction: Find the bottle we sip from when we feel thirsty at school!
quests.question: Water Bottle
quests.hint: It has a lid or cap that opens and closes tightly.
quests.explanation: Well done! A water bottle helps students stay cool and ready to learn.
quests.funFact: Many water bottles have a special cap so they never spill in a backpack!

quests.instruction: Touch the tool that presses a tiny metal pin through papers to join them!
quests.question: Stapler
quests.hint: It joins papers together with a tiny, bent piece of metal.
quests.explanation: That's right! We press a stapler down to join pages neatly.
quests.funFact: The tiny metal pins a stapler uses are called staples!

quests.instruction: Touch the round object with hands that tells us what time it is!
quests.question: Clock
quests.hint: You check it to see how much longer until your next class.
quests.explanation: That's right! We check a clock to see how much time is left.
quests.funFact: Clock hands have moved the same direction for hundreds of years, called clockwise!

quests.instruction: Find the small pouch we zip our pencils and crayons inside!
quests.question: Pencil Case
quests.hint: It usually has a zipper to keep everything safely inside.
quests.explanation: That's right! We zip our writing tools safely inside a pencil case.
quests.funFact: A tidy pencil case can help you find your pencil in just one second!

quests.instruction: Point to the tool with little marks that tells us how long things are!
quests.question: Ruler
quests.hint: It is long, flat, and has little lines and numbers along one edge.
quests.explanation: Yes! A ruler helps us draw straight lines and measure how long things are.
quests.funFact: Rulers can measure in centimeters on one side and inches on the other!

quests.instruction: Touch the flat table where we keep our books and do our work!
quests.question: Desk
quests.hint: You place your notebook and pencil on it before you start writing.
quests.explanation: Yes! A desk is the flat table where we sit to write and learn.
quests.funFact: Some classrooms use desks that can be pushed together to make small groups!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for someone who raises their hand right beside you in class!
quests.question: Classmate
quests.hint: You might sit next to this person or share a table with them.
quests.explanation: Yes! A classmate is another student who learns in your class with you.
quests.funFact: Working with a classmate on a project is a great way to learn together!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the grown-up who stands at the front of class!
quests.question: Teacher
quests.hint: This person stands at the front of the classroom most of the day.
quests.explanation: Yes! A teacher is the person who helps students learn every day.
quests.funFact: Teachers often spend extra time planning fun lessons for their whole class!

quests.instruction: Point to the flat sheet we fold, cut, and draw on in class!
quests.question: Paper
quests.hint: A pencil, crayon, or marker leaves its mark right on this.
quests.explanation: That's right! We use paper for writing letters and drawing pictures.
quests.funFact: Most paper today is made from trees that are grown just for that purpose!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the cheerful room filled with hungry students at noon!
quests.question: Cafeteria
quests.hint: You carry your lunch tray here when it's time to eat.
quests.explanation: Yes! A cafeteria is the room where students sit down to eat lunch.
quests.funFact: Some school cafeterias can serve lunch to hundreds of hungry students every day!

quests.instruction: Find the tool we dip into paint before we brush it onto paper!
quests.question: Paintbrush
quests.hint: After painting, it needs a good rinse in water to get clean.
quests.explanation: Well done! A paintbrush's soft bristles help spread color evenly.
quests.funFact: Artists use paintbrushes in many sizes, from tiny tips to big, wide ones!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the place with tall shelves where every book has its own spot!
quests.question: Library
quests.hint: You must stay quiet here so everyone can read in peace.
quests.explanation: Yes! A library is a quiet room full of books we can borrow and read.
quests.funFact: A library can hold thousands of books for students to borrow and enjoy!

quests.instruction: Find the waxy stick that comes in every color of the rainbow!
quests.question: Crayon
quests.hint: It feels waxy and comes in a big box of many bright colors.
quests.explanation: That's right! We use crayons to fill our drawings with bright colors.
quests.funFact: Crayons are made from wax, which is why they melt in hot sunshine!

quests.instruction: Touch the item with blank pages where we write our own words!
quests.question: Notebook
quests.hint: You carry it to class to write down what your teacher says.
quests.explanation: Yes! A notebook has empty pages where we write our own words and ideas.
quests.funFact: Some notebooks have a spiral of wire so the pages can turn easily!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the person carrying a backpack full of books to class!
quests.question: Student
quests.hint: This person carries a backpack and sits at a desk to learn.
quests.explanation: Yes! A student is a person who goes to school to learn new things.
quests.funFact: Students all around the world go to school to learn new things every day!

quests.instruction: Find the item with a cover and many pages full of stories!
quests.question: Book
quests.hint: It has a cover, and inside are many pages full of words.
quests.explanation: That's right! We open a book and turn its pages to read.
quests.funFact: Some books have thousands of pages, while others have only a few!

quests.instruction: Find the wet, colorful item that fills a picture with color!
quests.question: Paint
quests.hint: It comes in small pots or tubes of every color.
quests.explanation: Well done! Paint fills a picture with bright, wet color.
quests.funFact: Long ago, people made paint from crushed rocks, plants, and even berries!

quests.instruction: Touch the piece of furniture we sit on at our desk!
quests.question: Chair
quests.hint: Every desk in the classroom has one sitting right next to it.
quests.explanation: Yes! A chair is what we sit on at our desk in the classroom.
quests.funFact: Chairs have been used by people for thousands of years, even in ancient times!

quests.instruction: Touch the shiny white board a teacher writes on with markers!
quests.question: Whiteboard
quests.hint: Markers write on it easily, and a wipe cleans it right off.
quests.explanation: That's right! A whiteboard lets a teacher write and then wipe it clean.
quests.funFact: Whiteboard markers wipe away easily, unlike regular permanent markers!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the room with desks, a board, and your teacher!
quests.question: Classroom
quests.hint: This is the room where your desk and chair are found.
quests.explanation: Well done! A classroom is where students and teachers learn together every day.
quests.funFact: Some classrooms have cozy reading corners with soft cushions for story time!
